resolutions.researcher_notes: Old current_ref (egyptoil-gas.com/reports/the-western-desert-egypts-giant-petroleum-reservoir/, the HTML landing page for the same report) is now a dead/false page for this purpose: it 200s but the fetched body is a broken flipbook-viewer render with no extractable 'Abu Sennan' text (confirmed by byte-level grep, 0 hits). Found the report's own downloadable PDF at a live, 200-OK direct URL on the same domain: /wp-content/uploads/2020/03/The-Western-Desert-Egypt's-Giant-Petroleum-Reservoir-.pdf. url_verifier flags 'value not found' because it reads raw (FlateDecode-compressed) PDF bytes, not extracted text -- classic PDF false-negative per the verifier's own docstring. Manually confirmed via curl+pdftotext: the PDF's 'Natural Gas Infrastructure in the Western Desert' pipeline table lists a row 'Abu Sennan Spur | From: GPT | To: BED/Abu Sennan connector | Length 45 | Diameter 14 | -' -- an EXACT match to GEM's own Length=45km and Diameter=14in, confirming this PDF is (or reproduces) GEM's original source for this row. The pipeline is listed among the Western Desert's existing/in-service gas pipeline network (the report frames all 13 listed lines, incl. this one, as current infrastructure feeding the Mediterranean-coast distribution center via Abu Sennan field) -- this supports 'operating' by context; the literal word 'operating' is not required per status-inference convention. Secondary, weaker support for the area still being active/producing (not spur-specific): nsenergybusiness.com/projects/abu-sennan-concession/ (verified OK, contains 'Abu Sennan') describes ongoing Abu Sennan concession gas production through 2020-2025 (Al Jahraa field online March 2020; recent 2025 discoveries), i.e. the concession's gas-gathering infrastructure remains in active use. Tier set to medium: one strong, specific, exact-spec-matching source plus one general-area corroboration, not two sources both specific to this exact spur. No contradiction found -- both sources are consistent with GEM's operating status and specs.

Value 'Abu Sennan' (the feeding field) is corroborated by two genuinely independent sources. (1) egyptoil-gas.com Western Desert report PDF (verified OK 200; url_verifier flags 'value not found' but this is a raw-bytes/compressed-PDF false negative -- manually confirmed via pdftotext): the pipeline table's 'Abu Sennan Spur' runs 'From: GPT' into the 'BED/Abu Sennan connector', and the surrounding text states GPC's gas/condensate processing plant sits 'in Abu Sennan' (85 mmcf/d capacity), i.e. GPT is the Abu Sennan-area processing point feeding this spur. (2) General Petroleum Company's own official 2021 technical workshop presentation, hosted on GPC's own domain gpcnew.com (verified OK 200; same PDF-bytes false negative on the automated substring check, manually confirmed via pdftotext): verbatim -- 'GPT field is the first field discovered by GPC in Abu Sennan concession in 1981' and 'Abu Sennan concession is located in the northern Western Desert of Egypt ... GPC fields produce hydrocarbons mainly from Bahariya and Abu Roash reservoirs (SWS, GPT, NES, etc.)'. This independently ties 'GPT' unambiguously to the Abu Sennan concession/field and to GPC (matching GEM's listed Owner). Two independent origins (a trade-press market report vs. the operating company's own technical publication) both confirm the field/fuel source is Abu Sennan. No contradiction found.

StartLocation/EndLocation='Abu Sennan', District='Western Desert', Country='Egypt' are well corroborated by two independent sources: (1) GPC's own 2021 workshop PDF (verified OK 200; manual pdftotext check overrides the raw-PDF-bytes automated 'not found' flag) -- verbatim 'Abu Sennan concession is located in the northern Western Desert of Egypt (≈230 km2)'. (2) nsenergybusiness.com/projects/abu-sennan-concession/ (verified OK 200, contains 'Abu Sennan' directly) -- 'The Abu Sennan concession is located in the Abu Gharadig Basin in the northern part of the Western Desert in Egypt.' Both agree on Western Desert/Egypt for the Abu Sennan field itself. HOWEVER: EndState/Province='Matruh' (Matrouh Governorate) could NOT be independently confirmed -- no source found states the Abu Sennan concession sits within Matrouh Governorate specifically (multiple searches for 'Abu Sennan' + 'Matrouh/Matruh Governorate' returned nothing on point; academic sources place the Abu Gharadig Basin at roughly 29-30°N/28-30°E, which does fall inside Matrouh Governorate's large southward desert extent, but this is inference, not a direct citation). Flagging this as an unverified/uncorroborated sub-value for Baird's review rather than fabricating support for it; the two proposed refs support the rest of the Location value set (Abu Sennan / Western Desert / Egypt) at tier medium given the outstanding Matruh gap. No outright contradiction found.
